column1: # ratio_low and ratio_high are a 95% bootstrap interval from the submitted runs. They resample converged runs and hold each set's aborted-run count fixed; mlperf-h100-spread.csv also counts the draws that have no valid comparison when all submitted runs are resampled
column2: and gives intervals among the draws that have one. They treat runs as independent draws and describe spread within this submission pair
column3: not the uncertainty of the gain. MLCommons states averaged results vary very roughly +/- 2.5% for imaging benchmarks and +/- 5% otherwise; see provenance.yml.
